title.value: Process small refund requests automatically with a Zapier agent

introduction.value: A small SaaS owner has a Zapier agent handle refund requests under $50 from the past 7 days: it pulls Stripe data, checks the policy in Google Docs, and emails a confirmation. The author also used an agent for invoice follow-ups.

method.value: The author, who runs a small SaaS, gave a Zapier agent one plain-language instruction to handle refund requests under $50 from the last 7 days. The agent pulled Stripe data, checked the refund policy in Google Docs, and sent a confirmation email. The author did not define each step. The author also set up an invoice follow-up agent.

outcome.value: The author says the refund agent ran without field mapping. The invoice follow-up agent took two hours to set up and saved about ten hours a week. An early "handle all refunds" instruction led the agent to approve a $500 refund for a customer who had already been refunded twice.

notes.value: Put a hard cap in the action layer. The author says to never let the agent make financial decisions over $100 without a human check.

source_text.body:
Process small refund requests automatically with a Zapier agent
A small SaaS owner has a Zapier agent handle refund requests under $50 from the past 7 days: it pulls Stripe data, checks the policy in Google Docs, and emails a confirmation. The author also used an agent for invoice follow-ups.
Done with
ZA
Zapier Agents
What they did
The author, who runs a small SaaS, gave a Zapier agent one plain-language instruction to handle refund requests under $50 from the last 7 days. The agent pulled Stripe data, checked the refund policy in Google Docs, and sent a confirmation email. The author did not define each step. The author also set up an invoice follow-up agent.
How it went
The author says the refund agent ran without field mapping. The invoice follow-up agent took two hours to set up and saved about ten hours a week. An early "handle all refunds" instruction led the agent to approve a $500 refund for a customer who had already been refunded twice.
Worth knowing
Put a hard cap in the action layer. The author says to never let the agent make financial decisions over $100 without a human check.
Try it yourself
with
Zapier Agents
Copy prompt
Set up an agent that handles refund requests under [dollar amount, e.g. $50] from the last [number] days. For each request, have it look up the customer's payment in [payment tool, e.g. Stripe], check my refund policy in [Google Doc or link], and decide whether it qualifies. For qualifying requests, draft a confirmation email to the customer, and pause to show me the refund and email for approval before issuing the refund or sending anything; for the rest, list them with the reason they were skipped.
Original source: https://aegisai.in/zapier-ai-agents-automation-workflow-2026/
